title: 2A Gosford Castle Co Armagh, Markethill, Co. Armagh
seoTitle: 2A Gosford Castle Co Armagh, Markethill, Co. Armagh
description:
Hewitt Property Agents are delighted to present this luxury townhouse 2A, Gosford Castle, Markethill, Co. Armagh, to the rental market.


This exceptional and grand three bedroom townhouse is located within the prestigious Gosford Castle development, set in the heart of the 240-hectare Gosford Forest Park. Residents enjoy direct access to the park’s superb facilities, including play areas, cycling and horse-riding trails, and a pump track—making it an ideal location for nature lovers and families alike.


Gosford Castle offers both peace and convenience, situated just 10 minutes from Armagh City, 20 minutes from Newry, and approximately 90 minutes from Dublin 30min from Dundalk Co Louth 30min from Monaghan 30 min from Dungannon Co Tyrone 20 min from Banbridge Co Down 30min from portadown Craigavon area perfect for commuters. 

The attention to detail throughout Apartment 2A is second to none. The standout feature is the original ‘embrasure’/ ‘loop-hole’ windows on the front façade, dating back to 1837. These have been thoughtfully integrated in the modernisation process, with custom double-glazed windows constructed behind each one. 


Accommodation comprises spacious kitchen-diner, living room, ground floor bedroom with en-suite , two first floor double bedrooms (one with ensuite) 

Fibre broadband installed 
Gas heating 

This is a unique opportunity to be part of the rich history of Gosford Castle.

Viewing is strictly by appointment only.

No smoking
